comment: National certification rules, curated from ledger/national.json. Every value names the verified fact it comes from; a value whose fact is missing or not verified is emitted as not yet verified. reason explains a number that is a reading of the fact rather than its literal text.

NCCPA.name: NCCPA
NCCPA.fullName: National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants

cat1Accepted.reason: The app's PA categories for the sponsors NCCPA lists for Category 1 (AAPA, AMA PRA, AOA 1A, AAFP Prescribed) and the PANRE-LA Category 1 Self-Assessment credit NCCPA awards itself.

category2Note.value: Nursing-only contact hours count only as Category 2 for PAs.

windowStart.reason: The window runs from May 1 of the year the current certification was issued; a certification expiring in year Y was issued in Y minus 2 (NCCPA's own example: expiring 2020 counts May 1, 2018 to December 31, 2020). A record's issue date, when entered, is used instead.

deadline.value: 11:59 p.m. PT on December 31 of the expiration year

exam.value: Pass PANRE or PANRE-LA by the end of year 10 of the maintenance cycle.

panreLa.value: PANRE-LA: apply in year 6; 12 quarters across years 7 to 9; if not passed, up to three PANRE attempts in year 10.

newCertificantNote.value: New certificants count CME from their issue date (NCCPA). Set CME Cycle Start on this record if this is your first cycle.

AANPCB.name: AANPCB
AANPCB.fullName: American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (NPCB)

examRenewal.reason: Exam renewal is offered for FNP, A-GNP, PMHNP and ENP; ENP also needs a current FNP certification.

accepted.unverifiedItem: Which CE providers AANPCB accepts (the handbook says CE from an accredited provider; AMA PRA Category 1 acceptance is not stated)

formallyApproved.reason: Accredited CNE, AMA PRA Category 1 CME and Joint Accreditation, as the app names them.

totalOnly.reason: Contact hours from other disciplines including PAs are acceptable; up to 15 of the 75 need not be formally approved. A state-mandated course logged as State-Specific Required says nothing about its accreditor, so it counts as hours that need not be formally approved (never more than Non-accredited CE).

developmentNote.value: Complete one of the eight professional development categories.

value.text: ANCC's renewal handbook effective February 1, 2027 requires all 75 contact hours to be accredited or formally approved (APRNs: 25 pharmacology) plus one pathway: 75 more contact hours, practice hours, or scholarship. Which handbook applies depends on when you apply.

noGrace.value: No grace period; renew on or before expiration.

PNCB.name: PNCB

sevenYear.value: CPNP-PC and CPNP-AC: within each 7-year cycle, 4 Pediatric Updates modules (2 role-specific) and 15 contact hours of pediatric pharmacology.

unverified: The dates the 15 yearly contact hours must fall between (PNCB says only within the accepted date range)

excludedCategories.reason: ACLS and BLS cannot be used for any NCC certification; entries tagged or titled with them are left out.

ccaNote.value: Only CE earned after the Continuing Competency Assessment counts, and the CCA itself earns 5 hours. Do not log the CCA as a CE entry.

mateSchoolExemption.value: PA or advanced practice nursing graduates within 5 years whose curriculum had 8 or more hours of substance use disorder training satisfy it.
